=== Generated Script ===
Language: bash

```bash
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT_DIR="/home/vscode/AgentsToolkitProjects/${{var:app_name}}" VARIABLE_NAME="AZURE_SEARCH_ENDPOINT" VARIABLE_VALUE="${{env:AZURE_SEARCH_ENDPOINT}}" python3 - <<'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path

lifecycle = Path(os.environ["PROJECT_DIR"]).resolve() / "m365agents.local.yml"
name = os.environ["VARIABLE_NAME"]
value = os.environ["VARIABLE_VALUE"]
if not value:
    raise AssertionError("The variable value resolved to nothing")
lines = lifecycle.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
targets = ("target: ./.localConfigs", "target: ./.env")
target = next((index for index, line in enumerate(lines) if line.strip() in targets), None)
if target is None:
    raise AssertionError("The local lifecycle writes no runtime environment file")
header = next((index for index in range(target + 1, len(lines)) if lines[index].strip() == "envs:"), None)
if header is None:
    raise AssertionError("The runtime environment file declares no envs mapping")
indent = " " * (len(lines[header]) - len(lines[header].lstrip()) + 2)
end = header + 1
while end < len(lines) and lines[end].startswith(indent) and lines[end].strip():
    end += 1
kept = [line for line in lines[header + 1 : end] if not line.strip().startswith(name + ":")]
lines[header + 1 : end] = kept + [indent + name + ": " + value]
lifecycle.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
written = [line for line in lifecycle.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip().startswith(name + ":")]
if written != [indent + name + ": " + value]:
    raise AssertionError("The variable was not written exactly once with its value")
PY
```
